import MumfordLib.SourceComplexTorusTopology
import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyExteriorHomotopy

/-!
# Exterior cup comparison for the source Lie group

The topological uniformization now supplies the concrete homotopy equivalence
needed to consume the finite-torus exterior-cup calculation on the original
compact connected complex Lie group.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped Topology Manifold ContDiff IsMulCommutative

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {E H : Type*} {G : Type}
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
  [TopologicalSpace H] (I : ModelWithCorners ℂ E H)
  [TopologicalSpace G] [ChartedSpace H G] [Group G]
  [LieGroup I ω G] [T2Space G] [I.Boundaryless]
  [CompactSpace G] [PreconnectedSpace G]

include E I in
theorem compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPower_bijective (n : ℕ) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    Function.Bijective
      (singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of G) n) := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  exact singularCohomologyExteriorPower_bijective_of_torusHomeomorph
    (compactComplexLieGroupCircleHomeomorph (G := G) I) n

/-- Package the source exterior-cup comparison as a linear equivalence. -/
noncomputable def compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    (⋀[ℤ]^n (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1)) ≃ₗ[ℤ]
      IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) n := by
  letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
    FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
  exact LinearEquiv.ofBijective _ (compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPower_bijective (G := G) I n)

@[simp]
theorem compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv_apply (n : ℕ)
    (x : ⋀[ℤ]^n (IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of G) 1)) :
    letI : FiniteDimensional ℂ E :=
      FiniteDimensional.of_locallyCompact_manifold G I
    compactComplexLieGroupExteriorPowerEquiv (G := G) I n x =
      singularCohomologyExteriorPower (TopCat.of G) n x := by
  rfl

end Mumford.Analytic
